english_text: Mr President , a practical approach to this report will immediately highlight its most important virtue - the fact that European institutions will no longer be able to ignore the pitiful situation of human rights protection in daily life in the Member States . As the rapporteur says , this annual report will , in future , be valued and possibly even feared . Though I fully share Mr Sylla 's view , I must confess that I have some reluctance in accepting a report subjected to the pressure of current standards of political correctness , which passes over in silence more important considerations such as evident breaches of human rights and political freedoms in some Member States such as the Kingdom of Spain . Commissioner Vitorino , in paragraph 22 , the report clearly calls , as an urgent matter , for action to be taken in favour of prisoners who suffer from serious diseases . Bautista Barandalla , a Navarrian prisoner , suffers from an incurable illness . His case is the object of my written question to the Commission tabled last March . I invite everybody to take a look at Commissioner Vitorino 's response on 11 June 2003 . If I were you I would feel very ashamed of it , Mr Vitorino .
